paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

model_annotation: The donut chart, titled "Stimuli Type," illustrates the distribution of different types of stimuli used in Agency B, with a total of 38 stimuli across seven categories. The largest segment, colored dark green, represents "External News Article" (15/38), accounting for the majority of the stimuli. The second largest segment, in red, is "Draft/Other" (9/38). Following that, "Email" is shown in dark brown (5/38), "Press Release" in yellow (4/38), and "Intra-agency news article" in orange (1/38). Two smaller segments are "Organizational Report" in purple (2/38) and "Interview" in dark blue (2/38). Each category is labeled with its name and corresponding count over the total (38), and the segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top right, with no legend provided but labels placed directly adjacent to their respective slices. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of external news articles as stimuli, with the remaining types distributed in smaller proportions.
